name: Bali
description: Strong all-around wellness destination with yoga, spa, culture, healthy food, and beach options.
watchOuts: Long international travel time
Some areas require longer ground transfers

name: Costa Rica
description: Excellent for nature-led wellness, beaches, hot springs, wildlife, and active experiences.
watchOuts: Some itineraries can become more active than a relaxed group wants
Transfers between regions can be long

name: Thailand
description: Strong for meditation, spa, food, culture, beaches, and luxury wellness.
watchOuts: Best itinerary may require choosing between north and islands
Seasonality varies by region

name: Portugal
description: A good mix of coastal wellness, food, wine, culture, and light adventure.
watchOuts: October weather is milder than tropical destinations
Meditation-focused supply may be narrower

name: Greece
description: Strong for beach, food, culture, private groups, and upscale island experiences.
watchOuts: Island transfers can add complexity
Some beach destinations become quieter in October

name: Tuscany
description: Excellent for food, wine, spa, culture, countryside, and slow luxury travel.
watchOuts: Weak fit for a beach-focused request
Less naturally wellness-led than Bali or Costa Rica

name: Vietnam
description: Strong on food, culture, coastline and value; wellness is available but is rarely the headline.
watchOuts: North and south need separate trips or long internal flights
Weather differs sharply between regions in the same month

name: Japan
description: Quiet luxury, onsen, temple stays and food; excellent for a slow, structured group trip.
watchOuts: Costs run high for groups outside the cities
Spring and autumn need booking a year ahead

name: Sri Lanka
description: Ayurveda, tea country, temples and coast: the strongest wellness value outside Bali and Thailand.
watchOuts: Ground transfers between regions are long
The monsoon moves around the island, so route choice matters

name: Nepal
description: Meditation and mountain walking, with the valley's heritage and retreat centres.
watchOuts: Altitude and trekking grade must suit the group
Comfort level drops away from Kathmandu and Pokhara

name: Bhutan
description: Monasteries, valleys and low-volume luxury; a natural fit for a contemplative group.
watchOuts: The daily sustainable development fee is charged per traveller
Guide and itinerary rules make it the least flexible destination here

name: Kerala
description: Classical ayurveda and yoga in the backwaters, with strong retreat infrastructure.
watchOuts: Monsoon season runs June to August
Ayurvedic programmes usually need seven nights minimum

name: Morocco
description: Riads, hammams, markets and the mountains: a short-haul option with real cultural depth.
watchOuts: Summer heat in Marrakech and the desert limits daytime activity
Ramadan changes what is open and when

name: Peru
description: Sacred Valley retreats, walking and Andean culture, with a strong wellness-tourism base in Cusco.
watchOuts: Altitude affects the first two days and the group's pace
Inca Trail permits sell out months ahead

name: Mexico
description: Yoga and spa resorts on both coasts, with Maya heritage and food for the rest of the week.
watchOuts: Hurricane season runs June to November on the Caribbean side
Resort areas can feel insulated from the country

name: Iceland
description: Geothermal bathing, glaciers and clean air; a short flight for a restorative, outdoor-led week.
watchOuts: Weather changes fast enough to move an itinerary
Winter daylight is short and driving is limited

name: Croatia
description: Island coast, old towns and wine; wellness is secondary to food, water and scenery.
watchOuts: July and August are crowded and expensive on the islands
Group moves between islands depend on ferries

name: Spain
description: Food, wine, walking and coast, with a wide spread of price points for groups.
watchOuts: August heat makes inland cities hard work
Coastal resorts and quiet countryside suit different groups

name: Turkey
description: Hammams and hot springs plus deep history; strong value for a large group.
watchOuts: Coast and Cappadocia need an internal flight
Summer heat on the Aegean coast is intense

name: Kenya
description: Safari and coast, increasingly sold as a restorative week rather than a checklist.
watchOuts: Park fees add up quickly per traveller per day
Long game drives are a poor fit for low-mobility travellers

name: Fiji
description: Island resorts built for groups, with spa and water-based days and little travel between stops.
watchOuts: Long haul from North America or Europe
Cyclone season runs November to April
